D: A Broadway dancer bets he can turn an unknown chorus girl into a star by the next Easter Parade.
P: Serve the sweets when the Easter Parade fills Fifth Avenue.
S: the Easter Parade on Fifth Avenue
Egg and cress sandwiches cut into fingers, neat enough for an Easter bonnet crowd. Boil 6 eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise.
Warm gruyère choux puffs, a smart little snack for opening night. Boil 250ml water with 100g butter, beat in 150g flour and cool.
M: Roast leg of lamb with garlic and rosemary, roast potatoes and mint sauce. Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic slivers and rosemary.
W: Toasted hot cross buns with plenty of butter. Split 6 hot cross buns and toast until golden.
K: Pink cranberry punch with lemonade. Mix 1L cranberry juice and 1L lemonade in a jug with ice and sliced strawberries.

s.note: the Easter Parade on Fifth Avenue
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise. Spread on 8 slices of bread, add cress and cut into fingers.
Boil 250ml water with 100g butter, beat in 150g flour and cool. Beat in 4 eggs and 120g grated gruyère, pipe small balls and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.how: Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic slivers and rosemary. Roast at 180C for 1 hour 45 minutes with 1kg potatoes. Rest 15 minutes and serve with mint sauce.

w.how: Split 6 hot cross buns and toast until golden. Spread with 50g butter while hot and serve straight away. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Mix 1L cranberry juice and 1L lemonade in a jug with ice and sliced strawberries. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
